From the manufacturer
TRANSCEND THE LIMITS 
The ASUS ROG Azoth 75 wireless gaming keyboard has a gasket-mount design and three-layer dampening, hot-swappable pre-lubed ROG NX mechanical switches, ROG keyboard stabilizers, PBT doubleshot keycaps and switch lube kit, OLED display and tri-mode connection with SpeedNova wireless technology. 
Previous page
OLED DISPLAY & THREE-WAY CONTROL KNOB 
The OLED panel can show the keyboard status, setting indicators, multimedia info, custom animations, and system parameters. Adjustments can be made with the three-way control knob & side button. 
VERSATILE TRI-MODE CONNECTION 
Enjoy ROG SpeedNova wireless technology in 2.4 GHz RF mode or use Bluetooth mode to connect up to three devices at the same time or charge and play simultaneously in wired USB mode. 
ROG SPEEDNOVA WIRELESS TECHNOLOGY 
ROG SpeedNova wireless technology offers up to 2,000+ hours of stable, uninterrupted near-zero-latency gameplay in 2.4 GHz RF mode (RGB and OLED off). 
Next page
Previous page
SILICONE GASKETS 
The Silicone gasket mount design gives the Azoth a more cushioned and pleasant typing feel than traditional mechanical keyboards. 
SILICONE PAD 
The durable 3.5 mm-thick silicone pad absorbs noise. 
PORON FOAM 
The PORON foam absorbs case ping and hollowness. 
Next page
Previous page
ROG NX MECHANICAL SWITCHES 
Tuned for great keystroke feel and consistency with fast actuation. The switches have lubricated stems and base housings that offer a smoother click feeling and eliminate the spring bouncing noises. 
ROG NX Snow: Refined Linear 
Special tuning is done, coupled with a factory pre-lubing, to give the ROG NX Snow keystroke a very solid and clean sound, with “thocky” acoustics. 
ROG NX Storm: Refined Clicky 
Special tuning is done, coupled with a factory pre-lubing, to give the ROG NX Storm keystroke a very crispy and clicky sound, with “clacky” acoustics. 
Next page
Previous page
HOT-SWAPPABLE SWITCHES 
Swap and install your preferred switch type for a unique, customized feel. 
*It is not recommended to swap out switches when the keyboard is On to prevent short circuiting the keyboard. 
DIY SWITCH LUBE KIT 
The ROG Azoth includes a complete set of tools for DIY switch lubing. The kit includes a switch opener, keycap puller, switch puller, lube station, brush, and bottle of Krytox GPL-205-GD0 lubricant. 
ROG KEYBOARD STABILIZER 
This pre-lubed keyboard stabilizer has been specially tuned to deliver keystrokes that stay true to the original switch feel. 
*ROG Azoth is also compatible with costar stabilizers. 
ROG PBT DOUBLESHOT KEYCAPS 
ROG PBT doubleshot keycaps have a mid-height design (similar to a Cherry profile) and shorter stems to reduce key wobble, and provide long-lasting durability. 
*Keycap materials may vary by region. 
ERGONOMIC DESIGN 
The Azoth includes two pairs of keyboard feet of different heights, giving it three tilt angles to suit your preference.
